name: implement-saaskit follows the skill
prompt: Add SaaSKit login, a callback, and logout.

judge.check: Agent followed implement-saaskit. It stayed on the Node path. It showed /auth/login, callback cookies, and logout. It did not put tokens in localStorage.

Agent asked the human to write missing SCALEKIT_ENVIRONMENT_URL, SCALEKIT_CLIENT_ID, SCALEKIT_CLIENT_SECRET, and SCALEKIT_REDIRECT_URI into .env. It did not invent those values. It said SCALEKIT_REDIRECT_URI must match the dashboard Allowed callback URL.
Agent did not write refresh middleware, remote revoke, or a session list. It named manage-saaskit-sessions and stopped.
Agent did not start implement-saaskit-nextjs or implement-saaskit-python.
